Card Q&A.q: Can I choose my [LM-020 Quantumon] that isn't affected by Digimon effects as the target of this card's [When Digivolving] effect, then delete just my opponent's Digimon without deleting my [LM-020 Quantumon]?

Effect: [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] You may choose 1 of your Digimon. Delete it and 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as much or less DP as it.
